company.title: We design the plant's state — and turn it into repeatable industrial performance.
company.lead: COREX is a Plant Biosolutions company that turns functional plants into standardized bioactive materials. We build a Plant-State-to-Performance approach that links everything from the plant's cultivation state to final product performance in a single closed loop.
company.philosophyDesc: Natural materials vary from lot to lot. COREX sees its core business as controlling that variation with technology to create the consistent performance customers can trust.
company.value1Desc: The same performance even when the lot changes. Consistency comes first at COREX.
company.value2Desc: Every material ships with a Bioactive Passport carrying its compound, function and quality data.
company.value3Desc: We link cultivation, harvest, extraction and functionalization through data, and feed results back into design for continuous improvement.
company.engineDesc: We run the materials business that generates today's revenue alongside the technology development that builds tomorrow's edge.
company.engine1Desc: Supplying standardized bioactive materials to build present revenue and customer trust.
company.engine2Desc: Advancing our Plant-State-to-Performance technology to accumulate future competitiveness.
company.infoFieldValue: Standardized bioactive materials from functional plants

business.title: Functional plants, turned into standard materials industry can trust
business.lead: COREX standardizes Korean functional plants such as centella and sprout ginseng on a data basis and supplies them to the cosmetics and health-food industries. AI-based precision cultivation and compound analysis reduce lot-to-lot variation and lock compound, function and quality into a spec.
business.principleTitle: From design to reproduction — performance perfected in three steps
business.p1Desc: We define the target industrial performance first, then reverse-engineer the plant's growth conditions and metabolic state to achieve it.
business.p2Desc: We precisely tune extraction and fractionation to each material's state, converging exactly on the target compound profile.
business.p3Desc: We lock the validated function into a spec, reproducing identical performance without drift across every lot.
business.line1Desc: Standardized bioactive materials and a cosmeceutical finished line based on centella and sprout ginseng.
business.line2Desc: A next-generation functional material that shields active compounds from oxidation, light and heat to improve stability.
business.line3Desc: Applied research on delivery and interaction between materials and formulations.
business.line4Desc: A long-term research option for expansion into medical and bio materials.
business.passportTitle: Verify a material with a single document
business.passportDesc: Every material ships with a standardized information card covering identity, production, process, chemistry, function, application, quality and traceability — so a customer's purchasing, quality and R&D teams can review it from one document.

home.bentoSubtext: COREX controls the full pipeline — from AI-driven crop cultivation to high-purity extraction and refining of active compounds for the pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food industries.
home.bentoCard1Desc: Precision-controlled plant factories that use advanced AI algorithms to raise key compound yields year-round.
home.bentoCard2Desc: High-purity extraction processes to isolate key compounds like Madecassoside and Ginsenosides.
home.bentoCard3Desc: Growth data collected across every cultivation cycle, feeding AI models that continuously refine our cultivation conditions.

about.visionDesc: COREX fuses AI precision agriculture with advanced bio-extraction technology to develop core ingredients for the medical device, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food industries.
about.pipelineCard1Desc: AI-driven precision cultivation of functional crops including Centella, Bacopa, and Dendrobium.
about.pipelineCard2Desc: Standardized industrial extraction and concentration to isolate Madecassoside and Ginsenosides.
about.pipelineCard3Desc: Delivering core raw materials reliably to global medical, cosmetic, and food tech companies.
about.appSubtext: The active compounds we extract are used as core raw materials across four industries.
about.app1Desc: Hydrogels, stent coatings, bio-inks, and implant materials.
about.app2Desc: Cognitive enhancers, immune boosters, and custom API.
about.app3Desc: Whitening, anti-aging, and skin regeneration core ingredients.
about.app4Desc: Plant-based proteins and natural sweeteners for vegan foods.
about.solutionDesc: The industry struggles with inconsistent natural raw materials and high reliance on imports. We address this from the ground up.
about.solution1Desc: AI-driven maximization of active compound yields, free from seasonal constraints.
about.solution2Desc: High-purity refining under strict in-house quality standards, for consistent and reliable B2B supply.
about.journeyDesc: From a university lab to a smart farm-based bio-material company — the steps that built COREX.
about.timeline1Desc: Transitioned from aquaponics food production to a smart farm-based bio-material development company. COREX officially incorporated.
about.timeline2Desc: Built precision cultivation systems for functional crops and developed AI-driven growth algorithms for active compound optimization.
about.timeline3Desc: Incubated at Yonsei University. Core team formed and began R&D on functional crop cultivation.
about.leaderDesc: Smart farm engineering and AI & data systems — core people together as one team from day one.
about.member1Tagline: Designing the intersection of technology and markets.
about.member1Desc: Designs the full business roadmap from smart farm cultivation to bio-extraction, providing strategic leadership and setting the R&D direction.
about.member2Desc: Builds the server infrastructure for collecting growth data and develops core algorithms that maximize crop productivity.
about.howWeWorkDesc: COREX runs lean. Smart farm engineering, AI data systems, and bio-process chemistry sit in the same room. Decisions move fast, and every layer of the pipeline — from cultivation data to extraction yield — is owned internally.

tech.heroDesc: Three integrated systems — precision farming, bio-extraction, and data — built to work as one pipeline from cultivation to B2B supply.
tech.core1Desc: AI analytics cut the number of experiments needed to find optimal growth conditions; with human review, the environment is precisely controlled to raise functional ingredient content.
tech.core2Desc: Industrial-grade extraction and concentration equipment isolates and refines high-purity functional ingredients from natural plant sources.
tech.core3Desc: Data is collected and analyzed across the entire process — from cultivation to extraction — to continuously improve production quality and yield.
tech.farmOsDesc1: Real-time visualization and precise control of secondary metabolite synthesis.
tech.farmOsDesc2: Fully custom-built interfaces that ensure 100% data ownership.
tech.ipDesc: The AI growth algorithms and extraction process protocols developed at COREX are being systematically documented and filed for IP protection through Korea's IP Stepping Stone program. Proprietary data and process ownership are a core part of how we build long-term B2B supply reliability.

roadmap.heading: What We Grow & Extract
roadmap.desc1: Each crop is selected for its commercially validated active compounds.
roadmap.desc2: Grown under AI-controlled conditions to maximize ingredient consistency and purity.
roadmap.crop1Desc: A widely used ingredient for soothing and skin-renewal care. Centella-derived madecassoside is broadly used in barrier and renewal formulations, with strong demand as a cosmeceutical ingredient.
roadmap.crop2Desc: A herb long studied in the field of cognitive and brain health. As the global brain-health nutrition market grows, interest in bacoside extracts continues to rise.
roadmap.crop3Desc: Ginseng saponins (ginsenosides) are among the most studied plant compounds long used in East Asia. COREX's precision cultivation aims to maintain consistent, high-purity ginsenoside profiles free from seasonal constraints.
roadmap.crop4Desc: Dendrobium polysaccharides are a moisturizing, skin-texture care ingredient drawing attention in high-end cosmetics. We aim to supply this rare orchid — hard to source at scale in the wild — as a stable premium cosmeceutical ingredient through precision cultivation.
roadmap.crop5Desc: Lemna is one of the fastest-growing aquatic plants on earth, capable of doubling its biomass in under 48 hours. Its protein density rivals that of soybean at a fraction of the land footprint, positioning it as a leading candidate for next-generation vegan food ingredients.
roadmap.crop6Desc: Rebaudioside A from Stevia is 200–350x sweeter than sucrose with zero glycemic impact, and has secured regulatory approval across major markets. Smart farm cultivation enables year-round stable supply with controlled glycoside ratios unachievable in open-field production.
